summary: Iterates season entries in SeasonScoringDB matching each against all vehicle files; calls NationalityDriverInfoLoader(0) when all vehicle files match a season or when a season has no vehicle files. Guarded by VehicleArray being non-null.

operations.description: Guard on VehicleArray (dword_8AC394) being non-null; when it is null the entire body is skipped and the function returns early.
Read the first vehicle-file name pointer from the VehicleArray; if it is null use the default path byte_5EA438.
Guard on VehicleCount (dword_5C329C) being greater than zero; when it is zero or negative the loop is skipped.

do-while loop countdown over VehicleCount seasons, advancing through SeasonScoringDB (dword_7D2E48) by stride 18624 per iteration and addressing each season entry at an offset of 18196 from the row start.
Guard on VehicleFileCount (dword_8AC390); when it is zero or negative, fall through to the loader call for this season (no files to match).
Inner loop over VehicleFileCount vehicle files, advancing through the VehicleArray by stride 1060 per iteration.
Read the current vehicle-file name pointer at the inner offset within the VehicleArray; if it is null use the default path byte_5EA438.
Call sub_588410(seasonEntry, vehicleFileName) to test whether the vehicle file matches the season entry; a non-zero return keeps matching, a zero return means no match.
When sub_588410 returns zero for this season entry, break out of the inner vehicle loop so the loader call is skipped for that season.

Call NationalityDriverInfoLoader(0) when every vehicle file matched the season, or immediately when the season has no vehicle files; the call is guarded on the saved default path pointer v6 being non-null.
Return the loop result value (initialized from VehicleCount, decremented to zero, or the early VehicleArray guard value when skipped).

unresolved: Exact return convention of sub_588410 (match vs mismatch) is inferred from this call site and should be corroborated at 0x00588410.
Semantics of the 18196 sub-offset within each SeasonScoringDB row are not defined by this packet.
Relationship of a season entry to the vehicle files it must match is caller-supplied data, not established here.
The LEGACY abi label VehicleArraySearchAndReset conflicts with the observed match-and-load behavior.
